title: Laculite
summary: Extract Laculite to make a Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation.

fields.Extraction: Combine 3 Laculite to create Suspension of Laculite.
fields.Recipe: Suspension of Laculite plus any Vitriol produces a Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation. It grants a level 2 spell slot until Long Rest and replaces another elixir.
fields.Acquisition: Decrepit Village beach in the Underdark.
fields.Base value: 9 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
